API: phone_gap_jacobian(tripod,full_result) -> dict geom_id:{grad_q12,gap_m,status,support_scope}; phone_margin_linearization; optional pure linear_feasibility_step
scope: Phone only q0..11/fixedphone. Native mj_jac inside explicit calls only, two read-only point J per modeled row and counted. No test/import/geometry/Jac/LP/physics run performed.
sign: Raw query_phone_frame normal and support sets remain PHONE BODY despite world-named keys. Convert with full_result.k.R/p. n is hand-exit, dgap=n dot(dH-dP).
nonunique: Saved unique closest pair used if present; otherwise independent support-set means are a heuristic local plane direction, NOT a certified rotational subgradient/physical nearestpoint/load point.
missing: AABB/UNKNOWN/missing normal return gradNone, never zero; Root driver must fresh all214 geometry constraints for every proposal/final.
trust: Default q step max.02rad; no phone pose step in this helper; intersects true joint bounds without clip.
